Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Fanatics Collect is looking for a
**Software Engineer, Android**
to help build and improve the tools, systems, and processes that keep our marketplace running smoothly.
  
  
In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of engineering and marketplace operations, developing Android solutions and internal tooling that help our teams support collectors, sellers, and day-to-day marketplace activity. You’ll investigate operational issues, improve workflows, automate repetitive processes, and build capabilities that make our teams more efficient and our customer experiences more reliable.
  
  
You’ll partner closely with engineers, product managers, and Marketplace Operations teams to understand operational challenges and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving real-world problems, digging into how systems behave in production, and using technology to make complex processes simpler and more effective.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Develop, test, maintain, and improve Android applications and capabilities supporting Fanatics Collect and Marketplace Operations.
* Build internal tools and technical solutions that help operational teams manage marketplace workflows more efficiently.
* Partner with Marketplace Operations to understand pain points, identify root causes, and translate operational needs into technical solutions.
* Investigate and resolve application and marketplace issues, including problems that span the Android experience and supporting systems.
* Improve processes through automation, tooling, monitoring, and better access to the information teams need to resolve issues.
* Identify recurring operational problems and develop solutions that reduce manual effort and prevent issues from repeating.
* Debug production issues using logs, monitoring, analytics, and other diagnostic tools.
* Collaborate with product managers and engineers to determine when an operational issue requires a technical solution, product improvement, or process change.
* Write maintainable, well-tested code and participate in code reviews with other engineers.
* Contribute to the reliability, performance, and maintainability of the Android application.
* Participate in technical discussions and contribute ideas for improving architecture, tooling, development practices, and operational workflows.
* Create and maintain documentation that helps engineering and operational teams understand tools, processes, and common issues.
* Support the implementation and validation of solutions through development, testing, release, and production.
* Balance planned engineering work with operational needs and emerging marketplace issues.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* Professional software engineering experience with a focus on Android application development.
* Experience developing Android applications using Kotlin and modern Android development practices.
* Understanding of Android application architecture, lifecycle, networking, data persistence, and user interface development.
* Experience working with APIs and integrating mobile applications with backend services.
* Familiarity with software testing, debugging, source control, code review, and modern development workflows.
* Ability to investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions.
* Experience using logs, monitoring, analytics, or other diagnostic tools to understand application behavior.
* Ability to take ownership of defined technical problems and drive them through resolution.
* Sound judgment about when to solve a problem independently and when to engage other engineers or partners.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, particularly when working with non-engineering partners to understand operational problems.
* An interest in improving processes and using automation to eliminate repetitive or inefficient work.
* Ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
* Curiosity about marketplaces, commerce, collectibles, and the systems that support them.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
You’ll help make Fanatics Collect Marketplace Operations
**more scalable, reliable, and efficient**
.
  
  
Success in this role means operational teams have better tools to do their jobs, recurring issues become easier to identify and resolve, manual processes are reduced where appropriate, and marketplace problems are translated into durable technical improvements rather than one-time fixes.
  
  
You’ll develop a strong understanding of how the Collect marketplace operates and use that knowledge to identify where engineering can have the greatest impact.
  
  
**About Fanatics Collect**
Fanatics Collect brings multiple parts of the collecting experience together in one marketplace, giving collectors the ability to
**shop, vault, sell, and break in one place**
.
  
  
Collectors can browse and purchase collectibles, participate in Buy Now listings and curated auctions, manage vaulted collectibles, track activity such as bids and grading submissions, and access other services supporting their collections.
  
  
As the marketplace grows, the technology, tools, and operational processes behind these experiences are critical to creating a trusted and seamless experience for collectors.

**Description**
 We are responsible for billions of dollars of payments each month to millions of Amazon vendors across the globe. We delight our vendors by paying them when they want and how they want, accurately and on time.
   

  

 We build software applications that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually, rivaling the complexity and scope of dedicated payments fintech companies. Our systems decide how and when a payment happens, carry it out across the world's payment networks, and account for it — all under real regulatory, tax, and audit obligations, in every geography Amazon operates in.
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to work in a high\-paced environment leveraging the AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) within our core principles of engineering, to deliver faster and ship features incrementally.
   

  

 Ownership is the center of this role, and ownership here means the whole lifecycle rather than just the code. You will take features from working backwards from the customer through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and documentation — and you stay accountable for how they behave in production long after they ship.
   

  

 Own features and components of our payment systems end\-to\-end. The business problem and the technology direction will be understood; how to actually build it will not be, and that part is yours.
   

  

 Design the solution and make the tradeoffs. You will code independently, and you will have senior and principal engineers to pull in when a tradeoff is genuinely hard or when a design needs to line up with where the architecture is heading.
   

  

 Work directly with product managers and business stakeholders — finance, tax, and accounts payable operations — to understand what they need and why, so that you build the right thing. You will hear the requirement first\-hand rather than through a written hand\-off, and you will be expected to push back when the ask and the outcome do not line up.
   

  

 Ship incrementally. Large payment changes land safely through staged rollout and measurement, not through a single release.
   

  

 Reduce operational load. Our best work turns a recurring manual intervention into a code fix or a self\-healing mechanism, not another runbook step.
   

  

 Leave the system better explained than you found it. What you build should be maintainable and extensible by an engineer who has never seen it, which means clear documentation and design choices that hold up without you in the room.
   

  

 Raise the bar around you: code review as a teaching mechanism, mentoring engineers earlier in their careers, and getting new teammates productive on how our software is built, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.
   

  

 Building with agentic AI
   

  

 We are not experimenting with AI on the side — it is how we work. You will use AI agents across the development lifecycle: exploring unfamiliar systems, drafting and reviewing designs, generating and testing code, triaging production issues, and automating the operational work that used to consume a week of on\-call. We expect engineers to be strong directors of these agents and rigorous verifiers of their output. The judgment stays with you: you are accountable for what ships, whether you typed it or an agent did. Agentic capabilities are increasingly part of the systems themselves — automating decisions and investigations that previously required a human in the loop — and you will have room to build them.
   

  

 Why this team
   

  

 Payments is one of the few places in software where the business logic is genuinely hard, the scale is enormous, and a mistake has an immediate real\-world consequence — a vendor who does not get paid when they expected. If you want real ownership, global scope, and the freedom to build with the newest tools available rather than waiting for permission to try them, this is a good place to build a career.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience
* 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large\-scale systems
* Experience with cloud computing or web services or related areas
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding agents in real production work, with a clear point of view on where they help and where their output needs to be checked.
